# CMTFtoolbox

## Overview

The `CMTFtoolbox` package provides R users with two data fusion methods
that have previously been presented in the MATLAB sphere.

- `cmtf_opt`: Coupled Matrix and Tensor Factorization (CMTF)
  (<doi:10.48550/arXiv.1105.3422>).
- `acmtf_opt`: Advanced Coupled Matrix and Tensor Factorization (ACMTF)
  (<doi:10.1186/1471-2105-15-239>).
- `acmtfr_opt`: ACMTF-regression (ACMTF-R) as described in van der Ploeg
  et al., 2025 (see citation below).

Both of these methods were implemented using the all-at-once
optimization approaches as described in the papers above. This
implementation was achieved using the S4 Tensor object from `rTensor`
and the various conjugate gradient approaches from `mize`. Other
features of the package include:

- `ACMTF_modelSelection`: Combined random initialization and
  cross-validation approach for determining the correct number of
  components in ACMTF.
- `ACMTFR_modelSelection`: Combined random initialization and
  cross-validation approach for determining the correct number of
  components in ACMTF-R.
- `npred`: Prediction of Y for a new sample using an existing ACMTF-R
  model.
- `Georgiou2025`: An example dataset containing a tensor of inflammatory
  mediator data and a matrix of tooth microbiome data in a cohort of
  apical periodontitis patients (<doi:10.1111/iej.13854> and
  <doi:10.1111/iej.13912>).

## Installation

The `CMTFtoolbox` package can be installed from CRAN using:

``` r

install.packages("CMTFtoolbox")
```

## Development version

You can install the development version of `CMTFtoolbox` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("GRvanderPloeg/CMTFtoolbox")
```

## Citation

Please use the following citation when using this package:

- van der Ploeg, G. R., White, F. T. G., Jakobsen, R. R., Westerhuis,
  J., Heintz-Buschart, A., & Smilde, A. (2024). ACMTF-R: supervised
  multi-omics data integration uncovering shared and distinct
  outcome-associated variation. bioRxiv. 2025.07.28.667162;
  <doi:10.1101/2025.07.28.667162>

## Usage

``` r

library(CMTFtoolbox)

set.seed(123)
numComponents = 3
I = 108
J = 100
K = 10
L = 100
A = array(rnorm(I*numComponents), c(I, numComponents))  # shared subject mode
B = array(rnorm(J*numComponents), c(J, numComponents))  # distinct feature mode of X1
C = array(rnorm(K*numComponents), c(K, numComponents))  # distinct time mode of X1
D = array(rnorm(L*numComponents), c(L, numComponents))  # distinct feature mode of X2
Y = matrix(A[,1])
lambdas = array(c(1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1), c(2,3))

df1 = array(0L, c(I, J, K))
df2 = array(0L, c(I, L))
for(i in 1:numComponents){
  df1 = df1 + lambdas[1,i] * reinflateTensor(A[,i], B[,i], C[,i])
  df2 = df2 + lambdas[2,i] * reinflateMatrix(A[,i], D[,i])
}
datasets = list(df1, df2)
modes = list(c(1,2,3), c(1,4))
Z = setupCMTFdata(datasets, modes, normalize=TRUE)

cmtf_model = cmtf_opt(Z, 3)
acmtf_model = acmtf_opt(Z, 3)
acmtfr_model = acmtfr_opt(Z, Y, 3)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ACMTFR_modelSelection()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/ACMTFR_modelSelection.md)
  : Model selection for ACMTFR
- [`ACMTF_modelSelection()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/ACMTF_modelSelection.md)
  : Model selection for ACMTF
- [`FMS_cv()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/FMS_cv.md)
  : Compute Factor Match Score for two models.
- [`FMS_random()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/FMS_random.md)
  : Compute Factor Match Score for two models.
- [`Georgiou2025`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/Georgiou2025.md)
  : Georgiou2025 Apical Periodontitis data
- [`acmtf_fg()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/acmtf_fg.md)
  : Function value and gradient calculation for ACMTF
- [`acmtf_fun()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/acmtf_fun.md)
  : Calculate function value of ACMTF
- [`acmtf_gradient()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/acmtf_gradient.md)
  : Calculate gradient of ACMTF model.
- [`acmtf_opt()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/acmtf_opt.md)
  : Advanced coupled matrix and tensor factorizations
- [`acmtfr_fg()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/acmtfr_fg.md)
  : Calculate function value of ACMTF
- [`acmtfr_fun()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/acmtfr_fun.md)
  : Calculate function value of ACMTF
- [`acmtfr_gradient()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/acmtfr_gradient.md)
  : Calculate gradient of ACMTF model.
- [`acmtfr_opt()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/acmtfr_opt.md)
  : Advanced coupled matrix and tensor factorizations
- [`cmtf_fg()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/cmtf_fg.md)
  : Function value and gradient calculation for CMTF
- [`cmtf_fun()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/cmtf_fun.md)
  : Calculate function value of CMTF
- [`cmtf_gradient()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/cmtf_gradient.md)
  : Calculate gradient of CMTF model.
- [`cmtf_opt()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/cmtf_opt.md)
  : Coupled matrix and tensor factorizations
- [`computeFMS()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/computeFMS.md)
  : Compute Factor Match Score for two models.
- [`degenScore()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/degenScore.md)
  : degenScore
- [`fac_to_vect()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/fac_to_vect.md)
  : Vectorize Fac object
- [`initializeACMTF()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/initializeACMTF.md)
  : Initialize input vectors for the ACMTF algorithm
- [`initializeCMTF()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/initializeCMTF.md)
  : Initialize input vectors for the CMTF algorithm
- [`normalizeFac()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/normalizeFac.md)
  : Normalize all vectors in model output Fac object to norm 1.
- [`npred()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/npred.md)
  : Predict Y for new data by projecting the data onto the latent space
  defined by an ACMTF-R model.
- [`reinflateFac()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/reinflateFac.md)
  : Reinflate all datablocks from a model Fac object.
- [`reinflateMatrix()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/reinflateMatrix.md)
  : Create a matrix from a matrix of scores and loadings similar to a
  component model.
- [`reinflateTensor()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/reinflateTensor.md)
  : Create a tensor out of a set of matrices similar to a component
  model.
- [`removeTwoNormCol()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/removeTwoNormCol.md)
  : Remove two-norms column-wise from a matrix
- [`setupCMTFdata()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/setupCMTFdata.md)
  : Set up datasets for (A)CMTF input
- [`vect_to_fac()`](https://grvanderploeg.com/CMTFtoolbox/reference/vect_to_fac.md)
  : Convert vectorized output of (a)cmtf to a Fac list object with all
  loadings per mode.
